description: Sends one real test delivery of a saved webhook right now, with realistic sample lead data run through its actual field mapping and conditions, so you see it land at the receiving address. Take it after you save a webhook or after the other side changed something: "Let us see whether my CRM receives it." It needs the session and the webhook id from your list. A real request goes out with demo data, so say that a test entry may appear over there. Nothing on the campaign changes. Afterwards you can read what a test or copy address actually received. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: test webhook, test delivery, does my CRM get it, webhook check, sample lead

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.
